newsitem.title: UK: Soft oils steady, palm oil unchanged in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Soft oils steady, palm oil unchanged in Europe.

text.p: A firm dollar and higher Chicago soybean futures supported opening soft oil prices in Europe on Monday morning.
Dutch soy oil opened 1.50 to two guilders up while rape oil was 1.50 guilders higher a cross the board.
Concern over supplies of soybeans during the summer and higher weekly crush data was behind the firm Chicago market.
"We have no supply problems in Europe, but our market will follow Chicago to some extent with the dollar giving it a further boost," said one trader.
In the palm oil sector crude palm oil was unchanged after Jun traded at $550 a tonne cif.
Export figures release by SGS and Caleb Bert were seen as supportive but traders in Europe were puzzled by the Malaysian market which closed mostly lower.
Coconut oil started the at $5 down to $5 up while palmkernel oil was $2.50 to $7.50 higher.
